transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It’s my ankles — both of them are swollen and puffy. My shoes are feeling tight and uncomfortable.
Could you tell me when you first noticed the swelling in your ankles, how it came on, whether anything seemed to bring it on, and if you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
I noticed it a while back, and it seemed to come on gradually — I don’t know what brought it on. And no, I don’t have any allergies to medicines.
How much is the swelling affecting your everyday life, and could you tell me about any medicines you take — including anything new or recently changed?

It’s not too bad — mostly my shoes feel tight and I’ve been sitting with my feet up more in the afternoons. I take a few tablets: one for blood pressure that was changed a while back, a small water tablet in the morning, and one at night for cholesterol, but I can’t remember all the names.
Have you ever had any operations?
No, I haven’t had any operations.
Have you had any other symptoms along with the swelling in your ankles?
No, I haven’t had any chest pain or trouble breathing when lying flat, and I haven’t noticed any calf pain or redness.
Could you tell me whether the swelling in your ankles is there all the time or comes and goes?
It comes and goes a bit — sometimes it’s puffier than other times. I haven’t really kept track of exactly when.
What worries you most about your swollen ankles?
I’m a bit frightened it might mean my heart is failing, because my sister had heart failure.
Is there anything else about your past health you’d like to add?
I have high blood pressure, and I’ve been told my kidney function is a bit reduced. That’s about all I can think of.
Is there anything else you’d like to add about your medicines, including anything new or recently changed?
The blood pressure one is amlodipine, and it was increased from 5 mg to 10 mg about 6 weeks ago. The small water tablet I take in the morning — I still can’t remember its name.
Is there anything else you’ve noticed along with your swollen ankles that you’d like to add?
The swelling is usually worse by the evening and mostly gone in the morning after I’ve been lying flat. My socks leave marks on the skin, and it’s both ankles and lower shins about equally.
When did you first notice the swelling in your ankles — did it start suddenly, come on gradually, or are you not sure?
It was about 4 weeks ago, and it came on gradually rather than suddenly.
How bad is the swelling in your ankles — would you say it's mild, moderate, or severe, or you're not sure?
Mild, I’d say — maybe about 3 out of 10 discomfort, more uncomfortable than painful.
Is there anything else you’d like to add about the medicines you take?
The night tablet is simvastatin 20 mg. The morning water tablet is just a small one — I still can’t remember what it’s called.
Besides what you've already told me, have you noticed anything else going on with your body since the swelling started?
No, I haven’t noticed anything else — just that my usual shoes don’t fit comfortably anymore, so I’ve stopped wearing them.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
